tools.name: joysubscriptions_search_subscriptions
tools.description: Find subscriptions by customer name or email and status. Joy tool "search_subscriptions". Key needs scope subscriptions.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_subscription_details
tools.description: Full details of one subscription: status, plan, frequency, next billing, products, discount, payment. Joy tool "get_subscription_details". Key needs scope subscriptions.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_customer_subscriptions
tools.description: All subscriptions of one customer, newest first. Joy tool "get_customer_subscriptions". Key needs scope subscriptions.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_list_plans
tools.description: Subscription plans and the products that have a subscription option. Joy tool "list_plans". Key needs scope plans.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_subscriber
tools.description: One subscriber's profile and lifetime stats. Joy tool "get_subscriber". Key needs scope subscribers.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_upcoming_orders
tools.description: Upcoming orders that are not billed yet, soonest first. Joy tool "get_upcoming_orders". Key needs scope orders.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_list_recurring_orders
tools.description: Recurring orders already billed, newest first. Joy tool "list_recurring_orders". Key needs scope orders.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_failed_payments
tools.description: Orders waiting for a billing retry and subscribers with an invalid payment method. Joy tool "get_failed_payments". Key needs scope orders.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_dunning
tools.description: Payment recovery overview: pending retries and invalid payment methods. Joy tool "get_dunning". Key needs scope orders.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_analytics_performance
tools.description: Revenue, orders, AOV and recurring rate for a date range. Joy tool "get_analytics_performance". Key needs scope analytics.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_churn
tools.description: Churn rate, breakdown, churned MRR and daily trend. Joy tool "get_churn". Key needs scope analytics.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_retention_cohorts
tools.description: Retention by signup month. Joy tool "get_retention_cohorts". Key needs scope analytics.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_list_product_bundles
tools.description: Product bundles, newest first. Joy tool "list_product_bundles". Key needs scope perks.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_list_subscription_boxes
tools.description: Subscription boxes with a summary of each. Joy tool "list_subscription_boxes". Key needs scope perks.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_get_settings
tools.description: App settings and the widget configuration. Joy tool "get_settings". Key needs scope settings.read.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_pause_subscription
tools.description: Pause an active subscription. Joy tool "pause_subscription". Changes the live shop. Key needs scope subscriptions.actions.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_resume_subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused subscription. Joy tool "resume_subscription". Changes the live shop. Key needs scope subscriptions.actions.

tools.name: joysubscriptions_skip_next_order
tools.description: Skip the next scheduled order. Joy tool "skip_next_order". Changes the live shop. Key needs scope subscriptions.actions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: joysubscriptions_search_subscriptions · Public sink: joysubscriptions_search_subscriptions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: joysubscriptions_search_subscriptions · Public sink: joysubscriptions_search_subscriptions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
